title: Perturbation theory for infinite dimensional integrable systems
exact_target: Develop perturbation theory for infinite-dimensional integrable systems, including focusing NLS and multi-soliton behavior.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000012 (AMR-079-0012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 12.

status_qualification: The catalogue extract has incomplete sentences and a cut-off ending. The target is reconstructed from the complete primary Problem 12, retaining the focusing multi-soliton, Toda, sine-Gordon and periodic questions. The source’s defocusing progress and periodic KAM discussion are historical context, not fresh verification of integrability or settlement.
